Hui10 platform upgrade accelerates lottery shop onboarding

Acceler8 Ventures Plc (LSE: AC8, “AC8” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that its principal operating business, Hui10 Inc. (“Hui10”) is now accelerating the rollout of its Sports Lottery+ platform following the implementation of its upgraded Lucky World merchant application and shop management system.

The upgraded platform not only enhances the customers’ experience through its Sports Lottery+ App but also, importantly, improves the lottery shop owner’s user interface by simplifying the registration and activation process. Early results to date have seen an increase in daily shop connection rates which are supporting a faster expansion across Hui10’s multi-region rollout.

The updated platform uses a dedicated QR payment code linked to each lottery outlet’s Lucky World merchant profile, bank account, management interface and transaction history which is integrated with a voice-notification speaker providing real-time hands-free payment confirmation which delivers faster setup and lower costs to connect each shop. Furthermore, the QR-code and speaker configuration preserves payment, outlet-level reporting, customer-recognition, loyalty programme and repeat-engagement functions.
Daniel Levine, Chief Executive Officer of AC8, said:

“Continuing on from the success of the introduction of the Sports Lottery+ platform we have now improved how lottery shops are brought onboard to Sports Lottery+. The upgraded application and management system, together with the lower-cost QR-code and speaker configuration, have simplified activation and increased the number of shops we can connect each day. Our focus is now on converting faster connections into active retailers, transaction activity and repeat customer use.”
Joh. Berenberg, Gossler & Co. KG, London Branch
AC8 is a Main Market publicly listed company focused on driving shareholder value through creating and developing technology-enabled business opportunities.

Hui10 is a Beijing-headquartered technology group that has spent more than a decade developing digital infrastructure creating a new digital engagement and transaction layer within China’s regulated lottery ecosystem, including AI-enabled tools and Big Data capabilities.

Its technology enables transactional activity connecting consumers and merchants, supporting improved oversight, engagement, transaction traceability and operational insight. Hui10 has deep integration with national payment infrastructure, including UnionPay-certified point-of-sale technology, together with established commercial relationships with regulated financial technology service providers and institutions.

Hui10 aims to increase lottery participation through expanding consumer access throughout China, enhancing the customer experience through new digitally enabled products and services, and expanding its Lucky World platform across the existing lottery shop network.
